related: extracellular matrix-dependent immature T cell migration
extracellular matrix-dependent immature T lymphocyte migration

definition: The movement of a thymocyte through distinct intrathymic niches (e.g. medulla, cortex), where it receives a unique set of developmental cues required for T-cell development, dependent on extracellular matrix components including fibronectin, collagen and laminin.
label: extracellular matrix-dependent thymocyte migration
